sample_unit: mock myocardial viability reports (plus 14 preparation questions and 2 report questions, each repeated twice)

links.outcome: Validity of references cited in ChatGPT responses
links.effect: Reference validity remained an issue, as only one response had a valid reference.
links.quote: Reference validity remained an issue, as only one response had a valid reference.

links.outcome: Consistency of ChatGPT responses across repeated regenerations of the same prompt
links.effect: Consistency scored lower for preparation prompts (1.14 ± 0.66) than report prompts (1.67 ± 0.49); inconsistent responses mandate supervised use.
links.quote: However, empathy and consistency had lower scores in preparations (1.43 ± 0.76; 1.14 ± 0.66) than in report prompts (1.58 ± 0.51; 1.67 ± 0.49).

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-4o responses to simulated patient preparation questions and mock nuclear medicine reports, measuring appropriateness, helpfulness, empathy, consistency, and hallucinations.
